turns.question: What was the median order amount in EUR for non-cancelled orders placed in September 2026?
turns.answer: The semantic layer has no median order metric (median order value is not available here), so I cannot give that figure. The closest metrics are average order value (EUR), which is revenue over non-cancelled orders for the whole period, revenue (EUR) and orders; I can give any of these for September 2026 if you want.
